title: Cluster
description: Cluster is a convenient Minecraft plugin that automatically merges items of the same type lying on the ground. Items are combined into stacks of up to 64, keeping your world organized.
body:
Cluster is a convenient Minecraft plugin that automatically merges items of the same type lying on the ground. Items are combined into stacks of up to 64, keeping your world organized.

Features:

🔹 Automatic Clustering: Nearby items of the same type are merged.

🔹 Up to 64 per Stack: Prevents oversized item piles.

🔹 Performance-Friendly: Reduces lag caused by many items on the ground.
